alternative_outcomes: DOWN with realized probability 0.495 was equally plausible; the outcome was near a fair coin
a brisker +0.3% move would have been scored identically (no FLAT tier)
postmortem.applied_lesson: single pilot observation exercises the resolution/scoring path; it cannot establish predictive information (minimum sample 10-100). Predictability_estimate 0.10 (low) was consistent with the realized near-coin outcome: meta-forecast accurate.
postmortem.summary: P(UP)=0.505 issued vs 0.50 base rate; outcome UP by +0.044%. Brier 0.2450 vs 0.25 coin: an edge of 0.005 on a single draw, indistinguishable from noise and within the 0..1 sampling band. Directional hit is a modal-class hit, NOT evidence of skill.

resolution_block.resolution_source: pre-declared primary: coin gecko simple price (api.coingecko.com). spot_open from frozen cutoff snapshot (evidence inventory item BTC_USD_spot_coin_gecko); spot_close sampled after resolution_time from same source. fallback coindesk not used.

outcome_metadata.raw_metars: METAR HKJK 122100Z 05007KT 9999 BKN016 17/14 Q1024 NOSIG

postmortem.alternative_outcomes: an isolated convective cell producing 1-2 mm was the realistic YES scenario (~10% assessed); METAR may resolve hourly, so sub-hour onset could be missed by a discrete sample (recorded as unknown)
postmortem.applied_lesson: single pilot observation cannot separate calibration from luck; the B2/B4 baselines are the only comparison that matters at series scale and both align with the issued NO-leaning forecast.
postmortem.summary: P(YES)=0.10 issued. Observed outcome: NO. A calibrated 0.10-probability forecast on a NO outcome scores Brier (1-0.90)^2=0.01 and log_loss 0.105, which is GOOD calibration (closer than the 0.25 coin on the convenient side). If outcome were YES, this leg would be the honest rare-event miss the taxonomy expects. Nothing about this single event demonstrates skill beyond the weather-service baseline (B4).

resolution_block.resolution_source: pre-declared primary: HKJK METAR present weather (aviationweather.gov/api/data/metar?ids=HKJK). window [01:00Z,02:00Z]; observation obtained after resolution_time. fallback (open-meteo >=0.1mm) not used because primary returned data.
